feat(web-learner): add modular course detail components
- Introduced `CourseHeader`, `CourseCurriculum`, `CourseInstructor`, `CourseReviews`, and `CourseSidebar` components. - Implemented `CourseDetailPage` layout, combining the new components for a modular design. - Ensured responsive design and consistency with platform UI/UX standards.

feat(web-learner): implement course catalog with filtering, search, and pagination
- Added `CourseCard`, `CourseGrid`, `FilterSidebar`, and `SearchHeader` components. - Introduced a `CourseCatalogPage` layout featuring filters, search functionality, and a paginated grid of courses. - Ensured responsive design and adherence to UI/UX standards for browsing and discovery.

feat(web-learner): add exam management interface with card-based UI and history tracking
- Introduced `ExamCard` component to display exam details and statuses (new, in-progress, completed). - Created `ExamHistory` component for displaying past exam attempts in a table format. - Added `ExamStats` component to showcase key statistics such as average score, total exams taken, and hours practiced. - Implemented `ExamPage` layout with tabs for available exams and exam history, including filtering and searching functionality. - Ensured responsive design and adherence to platform UI/UX guidelines.

feat(auth): add two-factor authentication with TOTP, SMS, and email support
- Implemented comprehensive 2FA support, including TOTP, SMS, and email-based authentication. - Added reusable encryption module with AES-256-GCM for securing TOTP secrets. - Created TwoFactorAuth module with service, controller, and repository for managing 2FA methods and statuses. - Introduced backup codes functionality for recovery. - Added Prisma migrations for storing 2FA configurations. - Integrated Redis and NATS for OTP storage and notifications.

feat(auth): implement Google OAuth login and account linking functionality
- Added endpoints for Google OAuth login and linking existing accounts. - Integrated Google authentication with user registration and login processes. - Updated user model to support OAuth identities and metadata. - Enhanced user service to manage linked providers and account unlinking. - Included necessary environment variables for Google OAuth in .env.example.
